tagline: Protected Wildlife Sanctuary & Natural Habitat in Arunachal Pradesh

overview.short: Talley Valley Wildlife Sanctuary is a pristine sub-alpine plateau sanctuary in Lower Subansiri, renowned for its dense bamboo groves, ancient conifer forests, and rich biodiversity.
overview.description: Situated at altitudes ranging from 1,200 to 3,000 meters above sea level, Talley Valley is a designated biodiversity hotspot near Ziro. The sanctuary protects a unique plateau ecosystem of Pleioblastus simonii bamboo, blue pine woodlands, and mossy cloud forests, serving as a vital sanctuary for clouded leopards, Himalayan black bears, and rare pheasants.
